## 1 Inventory GRN Inventory Team Manual GRN New   [p.1]
The inventory team will receive the GRN and on GRN QR code will be generated   [p.1]
The GRN will capture complete information about the article, including color, size, and roll   [p.1]
details.   [p.1]
2   [p.1]

## Quality   [p.1]
check QC Check Inventory Team Manual QC check   [p.1]
During GRN creation, the system provides an option to send the goods for Quality Check (QC).   [p.1]
If QC is selected: stock will be usable only after QC completion.   [p.1]
If QC is not selected: stock will be directly usable post-GRN, and the system will not prompt for   [p.1]
QC.   [p.1]
At the QC stage, the user can receive quantities as per the invoice.   [p.1]
Any shortage or excess identified can be marked in the QC screen accordingly.   [p.1]
In system inspection, user can define the inspection definition 10%, 20% or 100%   [p.1]
3   [p.1]

## Quality   [p.1]
check QC Check Inventory Team Manual QC check   [p.1]
In case any stock get rejected then the system will create a debit note in the system that need   [p.1]
to be return to the supplier.   [p.1]
4   [p.1]

## Merchant Report Notification Procurement Team System Notification   [p.1]
system will notification to the Procurement Merchant about the RM quality and then they will   [p.1]
discuss the with the supplier for replacement of fabric .   [p.1]
5   [p.1]

## Return to   [p.1]

## Supplier Common GDI to Supplier Inventory Team Manual Common GDI   [p.1]
In case supplier agrees to replace the fabric then the team create the return to the supplier GDI   [p.1]
and dispatch the goods.   [p.1]

before GDN. Move the rejected stock in on non-inventory site. so that stock taking time if any   [p.1]
good not pick by supplier, then that qty not visible in stock report.   [p.1]

## 8 Inventory GRN Inventory Team Manual GRN New   [p.1]
make sure before GRN. GDN will be created against Rejected goods. Otherwise system not   [p.1]

## 9 Inventory Production Material transfer Inventory Team Manual NA   [p.1]
In the case of production, the production team will raise a GDI (Goods Dispatch Instruction)   [p.1]
request to the inventory team against the respective production order.   [p.1]
10 Inventory Production GDI & Pick list Inventory Team Manual GDI and Pick list   [p.1]
The inventory team will prepare goods as per the requested quantity and create a pick list.   [p.1]
Multiple pick lists can be generated against a single GDI based on physical stock availability.   [p.1]

## 11 Inventory Production Goods GDN Inventory Team Manual GDN   [p.1]
Once the pick list is finalized, the inventory team will generate the GDN (Goods Dispatch Note).   [p.1]
After GDN creation, the system will automatically reduce the dispatched stock from inventory.   [p.1]
